newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-OPEN CHAMPION LEHMAN DELAYED BY PLANE PROBLEM.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OPEN CHAMPION LEHMAN DELAYED BY PLANE PROBLEM.

text.p: British Open champion Tom Lehman's arrival in Scotland for this week's Loch Lomond World Invitational has been delayed because of a technical fault on a plane built by the event sponsors.
Lehman, Payne Stewart and Tommy Tolles were due to fly directly from the Western Open near Chicago on Sunday night on a Gulfstream jet.

But a tournament spokesman said a mechanical problem prevented their plane taking off. So instead of arriving as planned at 0700 local time (0600 GMT) on Monday, they were due to land at 2000 (1900 GMT).
That left the trio with just one practice round on Tuesday ahead of Wednesday's start to the final event before next week's British Open at Royal Troon.
